summary: Authorization becomes the registered client policy intersected with git-derived scope resolved from the invoke envelope on every call. The grant token, the agent_grants table, expiry, and use counts are removed, and host approval keeps its scope, challenge, and consequence bindings without a signature. Worker evidence signing under CD-0067 D6 is out of scope and keeps the client key registry and the nonce table. Approval challenges re-anchor to the session identity tuple, blocked-session Product scope moves to the session record, and the three unbuilt revocation methods are removed. This declines the core-issued opaque session handle CD-0071 D4 anticipated.
title: Capability scoping replaces the grant token
